_why: Sources that are polled every hour and correctly record an absence. They are NOT broken collectors, and an agent must not file a bug for them -- but they stay visible under `expected_silent` on the status page, because a recorded absence is a finding and hiding it would be the opposite of this project. Remove an entry the moment the source starts answering.

p2p_basis.csv.NGN: polled hourly, returns no ads at ~USD 500 on both sides; kept so the absence is on the record
p2p_basis.csv.GHS: polled hourly, returns no ads at ~USD 500 on both sides; kept so the absence is on the record
p2p_basis.csv.ETB: polled hourly, returns no ads at ~USD 500 on both sides; kept so the absence is on the record
p2p_basis.csv.BWP: polled hourly, sell-side ads only and none on the buy side, so no buyer's price exists to publish

providers_usdmxn.csv.Xoom: Wise's public comparisons API stopped listing Xoom as a USD->MXN competitor on 2026-09-05; confirmed live on 2026-09-11 by querying the same endpoint the collector uses -- Xoom is simply absent from the provider list Wise returns, not a parsing or collector fault

providers_audphp.csv.HSBC Australia: Wise's public comparisons API stopped listing HSBC Australia as an AUD->PHP competitor after the 2026-09-12T22:05 run; confirmed live on 2026-09-13 by querying the same endpoint the collector uses at every ladder size (200/1000/5000/25000/50000) -- HSBC Australia is simply absent from the provider list Wise returns, not a parsing or collector fault

withdrawal_fees.csv.coinbase: Coinbase's stablecoin withdrawal page is login-gated, so tools/check_fees.py never polls it at all -- the source_ok=False row is a one-time seed, not a failing check. Its trading fees are covered instead by the 90-day manual-verification clock in check_fees.py's check_manual().
